svg.text: Big planets cannot conduct their heat away, and the heat source itself is fading.
can a body conduct its heat out?
Only Vesta-sized bodies sit below the line.
Everything larger must convect, or stay hot.
and is the source still running?
Radiogenic heating has fallen about fourfold.
⁴⁰K and ²³⁵U dominated the young Earth; both are now spent.
